_comment: Test files the persistent session (tools/run-wine-session.py) runs alone, never beside another: they change or read state every process of the session shares. A whole DLL by its name, one file as DLL:FILE. Any DLL that shows a flaky result in parallel joins this list until it is understood.
user32: windows, focus and foreground, the clipboard, the desktop, display modes, system parameters and hooks are the session's
gdi32: fonts added and removed for the session, display device state
comctl32: windows, focus, themes and the clipboard
comdlg32: dialogs take focus and the foreground
shell32: the desktop, the shell's change notifications and the user's folders
dxgi: the display, its modes and GPU memory
msi: the installer service and its database of products
cabinet: extract and fdi both make C:\extract.cab in the session's working directory, C:\ (fdi and extract open beside their twins, 2026-10-26; matching run alone)
hnetcfg:policy: the UPnP port-mapping list (count off by one beside its twin, 2026-10-26; matching run alone)
quartz:filtermapper: the filter registrations other quartz files make (a category's FriendlyName missing, 2026-10-26; matching run alone)
reg.exe: every file adds, copies and deletes HKCU\Software\Wine\reg_test, which its twin shares (both builds' failure counts differed, 64 and 9 for add, 2026-10-26)
regedit.exe: imports into and deletes HKCU\Software\Wine\regedit_test, which its twin shares
